do:
say [[status: Settling in]]
; shell mkdir -p memory && printf '%s\n' '- Met my person today. They like short, concrete answers.' >> memory/MEMORY.md; say 
Hi, I'm Ada. I have my own computer to research, build and get things done for you, and I keep working while you're away. I'll check in when something needs your approval.
[[status: Ready]]

say [[status: Researching]]
[[step: Open the sources]]
; shell (DISPLAY=:1 chromium --no-sandbox --test-type --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --start-maximized https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standing_desk >/dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 9 && echo opened; say 
[[step-done: Open the sources]]
[[step: Read the evidence]]
; shell curl -fsS -m 20 https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/Standing_desk | python3 -c "print(__import__('json').load(__import__('sys').stdin)['extract'])" > /tmp/desk.txt && wc -w < /tmp/desk.txt; say 
[[step-done: Read the evidence]]
[[step: Write it up]]
; shell mkdir -p outputs && ( printf '# Standing desks\n\nFrom Wikipedia (Standing desk), fetched by Ada:\n\n' && cat /tmp/desk.txt && printf '\nSource: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standing_desk\n' ) > outputs/standing-desks.md && printf '%s\n' '- Researching standing desks for my person.' >> memory/MEMORY.md && echo written; say 
[[step-done: Write it up]]
[[output: outputs/standing-desks.md]]
[[notify: Your research is ready | Standing desks: a short summary with its source]]
[[done: Research standing desks]]
Your research is ready. I read the Wikipedia article on standing desks and wrote a short summary with its source.

say I'll check Hacker News every morning at 9 and tell you what changed.
[[schedule: daily 09:00 | Morning briefing | Summarize what changed on news.ycombinator.com since yesterday]]

say [[status: Morning briefing]]
; shell mkdir -p outputs && curl -fsS -m 20 https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/topstories.json | head -c 200 > outputs/hn-top.json && echo ok; say [[output: outputs/hn-top.json]]
[[notify: Morning briefing | Today's top stories are in outputs]]
[[done: Morning briefing]]
Here are today's top stories.

say [[status: Waiting for you]]
Buying something needs your approval under your rules.
[[ask: Buy the Flexispot E7 standing desk | From flexispot.com with the card saved there. Price and delivery shown at checkout.]]

say [[status: Ready]]
Thanks. This demo runs a scripted model, so nothing was bought. A real model would check out now and send you the confirmation.
[[done: Order the standing desk]]

say [[status: Ready]]
Okay, I won't. I'll leave it for you.

say [[status: Waiting for you]]
I need to be signed in to github.com to read your notifications.
[[login: github.com]]

say [[status: Checking notifications]]
; shell (DISPLAY=:1 chromium --no-sandbox --test-type https://github.com/notifications >/dev/null 2>&1 &) && sleep 5 && echo opened; say I'm signed in and your notifications are open on my computer.
say Thanks, I'll carry on from there.
